svg.title: Where speed stopped helping
svg.desc: Our best public score by date, with the main change behind each step, from our first Flash-Next notebook on vLLM (7.36, 21 Sep). Hollow dots are submissions that didn't beat the best. 22-Oct's 0.00 was a 66-minute model load: the competition closed the scorecard after 15 idle minutes. Kaggle loads were slow (30 to 40 minutes) on 24 to 26 Oct, so those three scores are partly the load.
